c: --- All testimonials come from users in the course's official discord server. > Want to share your experience with the course? Let us know in the server! --- ChrisHagedorn: > As a self-taught software engineer, I initially doubted the value of platforms like LeetCode, thinking they did not teach on-the-job skills. My initial motivation for taking the course stemmed from the belief that companies were showing me exactly what they wanted, and success merely stems from completing the marathon of preparation. However, as I progressed through the course, I realized it was instilling an invaluable set of problem-solving principles that extended way beyond career success. > > The course simplified what seemed like a daunting task into something incredibly manageable. It provided a structured, step-by-step roadmap that systematically tackled complex topics, emphasizing principles of logic and problem-solving that quite literally unlock your brain. > > The entire preparation experience was full of highs and lows. Looking back, I would make the same decision to do it again. Plus, the Discord support group was fantastic, and the real win? The friends we made along the way. > > Rating: 10/10 --- floatingGround: > It's definitely worth the money when I consider the time saved and the sense of stability gained. Efficient, elite prep. THANK YOU!! (Before, I was just just blindly stitching different resources together using my best guess of what to prioritize (using websites like leetcode, geeksforgeeks, progamiz and books like the C++ Programming language). > > Rating: 10/10 --- Cait1277: > This course really broke down DSA in a way that was way more accessible to me as a bootcamp grad than other resources I was trying. The way it clearly illustrates signs of when to use what approach has made learning the patterns and knowing what to do significantly faster for me than when I was trying to learn them by just doing problems or following other guides. I can't recommend this resource enough, and everyone from my bootcamp that's bought the course so far has also found value in the course. Overall, I feel this course has firmly set me up for success with leetcode problems as I search for my first software job. > > Rating: 10/10 --- 369-shar: > This course has everything I ever needed all in one place. I used to struggle solving even the most basic questions since I had no direction, but this course has provided me a good direction and has really helped my problem solving abilities. Even my solutions have improved so much ever since taking the course. I never thought I would solve more than 10 questions on leetcode, but after this course I have solved more than a 100 problems and there's still so much to learn and do. The course is perfectly structured and if you are not afraid to grind, then with this course there's nothing stopping you. > > Rating: 10/10 --- ranawareviraj: > The best resource out there to prepare for coding interviews. It has all the required materials in one place. Important data structures, algorithms as well as techniques. Clear and concise yet easy to comprehend. Every technique is explained thoroughly with approach, detailed time and space complexity analysis. Code walk-throughs and animations make it easy to understand solution/approach. > > Lastly, the most important aspect of the course is support from the author on the discord channel. Really appreciate quick response to the queries. > > Rating: 10/10 --- (User wishes to remain anonymous): > This course was the number one reason I was able to land an L5 offer at FAANG. The interviewers gave glowing feedback to my recruiter on my performance in the coding components of my interview, which was relayed to me. Coming from a non-FAANG background, the upfront cost of the course is a tiny investment when compared with the increased compensation that comes with a competitive big tech role. > > Rating: 10/10 --- codingnectar: > This is an amazing course for various skill levels. If you are a beginner, it will teach you the fundamentals of data structures and how they can be used in algorithms. If you are a skilled coder, this course will reinforce many topics you know, as well as show you tricks/tools that you may not have seen. Although I had quite a bit of experience with DSA, this course was amazing practice and taught me many ways to tackle problems for my upcoming interviews. You will go through in-depth cycles of fundamentals review -> beginner-level practice problems -> advanced topic problems. This cycle will start you slow and at the end have you tackling problems you once thought were very difficult. It is a very thorough course, but also concise enough to tackle in 1-2 months if you are currently interviewing or have interviews coming soon. Lastly, the discord is very active and many users (including author!) are there to help you along your journey. Huge shout out to the author for his dedication and commitment to this course. > > Rating: 10/10 --- _gainsville: > DSA for interviewing and DSA taught in Academia are two different skills and this course captures the former in an astute and compendious manner.
